about: CHASING THE WDC: the career. Read by native/src/career.cpp. Everything a page says about the career comes from this file and story.json; nothing is hard-coded in the drawing code.

paints.name: PRIMER GREY
paints.line: primer grey. dad says it is 'a colour'.

paints.name: MIDNIGHT
paints.line: midnight purple. very serious. very spooky.

cast.name: CASTELLAN
cast.line: karting since she was four. has a real truck. annoyingly nice about it.

cast.name: VOSS
cast.line: says he is 'only here for the mileage'. has said it for three years.

cast.name: OKONKWO
cast.line: has never made a mistake. has never had fun either.

cast.name: BRAMBLE
cast.line: apologises when he overtakes you. means it.

cast.name: CROW
cast.line: from Gravenmoor. does not talk about Gravenmoor.

cast.name: QUILL
cast.line: brakes later than physics allows. physics usually wins.

cast.name: LARKSPUR
cast.line: drives to one playlist. if it is a slow song, so is she.

cast.name: TANSY
cast.line: started last month. is already faster than she should be.

cast.name: PIKE
cast.line: his mum runs the paddock cafe. free chips if you let him past. (do not.)

cast.name: DRUMMOND
cast.line: will tell you about his sim rig. is telling you now.

cast.name: MUDD
cast.line: has never finished a race with all four corners. the car is 40% tape.

ghost.name: NUMBER 78
ghost.line: went into the fog at Gravenmoor in 1978. the lap was never finished.

seasons.name: THE VAN YEARS
seasons.blurb: a borrowed car, a white van, one dad.

events.title: THE FIRST ONE
events.line: I'll be at the front if you need anything.

events.title: TEST DAY
events.line: We are testing you. The car has already passed.

events.title: IN THE DUNES
events.line: You're braking too early for turn three. Sorry. Is that annoying?

events.title: HOME RACE
events.line: Please don't crash in front of Mrs. Albright.

events.title: THE PAPERWORK RACE
events.line: In my defence, the form had two sides.

events.title: FIGURE OF EIGHT
events.line: If I get in your way, sorry in advance. And afterwards.

events.title: THE LAST ROUND
events.line: This is usually where I win it. No pressure. (Some pressure.)

events.title: THE INVITATION
events.line: I do not believe in ghosts. I do believe in timing loops.

seasons.name: THE SEAT
seasons.blurb: a phone call, a truck with a kitchen, the same rival.

events.title: THE NEW SEAT
events.line: I told them to call you. Don't make it weird.

events.title: IT ALWAYS RAINS
events.line: I have fitted the wet tyres. I have also fitted a towel.

events.title: THE FUN RACE
events.line: Last car each lap goes home. I have never gone home.

events.title: THE HILL EVERYBODY TALKS ABOUT
events.line: Promise me you'll at least think about lifting.

events.title: FOR SCIENCE
events.line: Night. Rain. Monaco. Three things I would not combine.

events.title: THE GREEN ONE
events.line: I'll wave from the car park. Once. That's the lap.

events.title: TEAM BUILDING
events.line: I booked it. I have feelings too. They are mostly this.

events.title: THE MOUNTAIN
events.line: Nice little series. I'm only here for the mileage.

events.title: ONE SEAT
events.line: Same car, same team. May the least annoying one win.

events.title: THE SECOND ENVELOPE
events.line: It waits for you at the bridge now. It never used to wait.

seasons.name: CHASING THE WDC
seasons.blurb: the garage next to the bins. the big one.

events.title: THE BIG ONE
events.line: They cannot afford a good driver. They can afford you.

events.title: AND THEN A CASTLE
events.line: Mum sends her love. And a bag of chips. I ate the chips.

events.title: MEDIA DAY
events.line: Three laps. Same car. Loser buys chips. I like the big chips.

events.title: CLOSER THAN THEY LOOK
events.line: I parked the van next to a yacht. The yacht has complained.

events.title: SUMMER BREAK
events.line: My idea of a holiday is a gravel car park. You are welcome.

events.title: SEVEN KILOMETRES OF FOREST
events.line: I do not make mistakes. I have checked.

events.title: NO FAVOURS
events.line: If it comes down to the last race: no favours. Promise.

events.title: ONE LAP
events.line: Do not think. Thinking is my job. You have seen how that goes.

events.title: PRECISE. COLD.
events.line: It gets foggy here too. Not the same kind.

events.title: THE DECIDER
events.line: Minus four hundred dollars and a ham sandwich. Look where we are.

events.title: THE LAST NIGHT AT GRAVENMOOR
events.line: Somebody should go and finish that race with it. So. Go on.

modes.name: ELIMINATION
modes.line: last car each lap goes home.

modes.name: HOT LAP CHALLENGE
modes.line: bronze, silver, gold. the clock is mean.

modes.name: THE 78
modes.line: midnight. fog. it has your number.

modes.name: RALLYCROSS
modes.line: six of you. gravel. no rules.
